items.raw_excerpt: Four individuals were detained in Bareilly for selling non-veg food along Kanwariya routes, violating local regulations during the pilgrimage.
items.summary_en: Four people were detained in Bareilly for selling non-veg food along Kanwariya pilgrimage routes. The sales broke local rules during the pilgrimage. Their shop was also razed by officials.

items.raw_excerpt: Fast-track approval has been granted for the development of more than 1200 homes in North Auckland, where treated wastewater will be trucked off-site when needed.
items.summary_en: A plan to build more than 1,200 homes in North Auckland has been given fast-track approval. Treated wastewater will be trucked away from the site when needed.

items.title_en: Fast-track approval for 1,200 new homes in North Auckland

items.summary_en: Orange Village in Ho Chi Minh City was planned as a shelter for thousands of Agent Orange victims. After nearly ten years, the village is still not built. It remains only an unrealized dream, officials say.

items.title_en: Orange Village project remains a dream for Agent Orange victims

items.raw_excerpt: BJP demands investigation into alleged fund misappropriation in Udupi's Sanjeevini women’s self-help groups, urging accountability and transparency.
items.summary_en: India's ruling BJP party has asked for a high-level investigation into how Sanjeevini women's self-help groups in Udupi district handle money. The party says the funds may not have been managed properly. Leaders want the district to check the accounts and be transparent.
items.summary_ko: 인도 여당 BJP가 우두피 지역 산지비니 여성 자조모임의 자금 관리 문제를 조사해 달라고 요청했습니다. 당은 모임 자금이 제대로 관리되지 않았을 수 있다고 주장합니다. 지도부는 회계 점검과 투명한 처리를 요구하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: BJP demands probe into Udupi women's group funds
items.title_ko: BJP, 우두피 여성 자조모임 자금 조사 촉구
items.title_original: BJP demands high-level probe into alleged irregularities in Sanjeevini SHGs in Udupi district

items.raw_excerpt: The union representing child safety workers in Queensland has highlighted concerns about the possible removal of a key reporting tool.
items.summary_en: The union for child safety workers in Queensland is worried. A key reporting tool may be removed. Workers say the tool is important for their safety.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드에서 아동 안전 업무를 맡은 직원들의 노조가 핵심 보고 도구가 없어질까 우려하고 있습니다. 노조는 이 도구가 직원들의 안전을 지키는 데 꼭 필요하다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Queensland union worried about child safety reporting tool

items.raw_excerpt: Listen live: RNZ's Jimmy Ellingham in Ohakune at 5.05pm
items.summary_en: Workers need one more day to fix Ohakune's water supply. The council says water restoration is delayed by 24 hours. Residents must wait a bit longer for tap water.

items.raw_excerpt: Passenger rail service between Kemi, Tornio and Haparanda was discontinued in 1988, leaving the border region without a direct rail link for decades.
items.summary_en: Passenger trains stopped running between Kemi, Tornio and Haparanda in 1988. The border area had no direct rail link for decades. A new rail connection now brings the towns back together.
items.summary_ko: 1988년 케미, 토르니오, 하파란다 사이를 다니던 여객 열차가 끊겼습니다. 국경 지역은 수십 년간 직결 철로가 없었습니다. 이제 새 철로가 두 나라의 마을을 다시 이어 줍니다.
items.title_en: New rail link reconnects Finland and Sweden
items.title_ko: 핀란드와 스웨덴을 다시 잇는 새 철로

items.raw_excerpt: Dunedin students on free power deals are causing extreme peaks - leaving them cold and in the dark - and costing the lines company several hundred dollars to fix.
items.summary_en: Students in Dunedin on free power deals cause extreme power peaks. This leaves them cold and in the dark. The lines company has to fix the problem, which costs several hundred dollars.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay plans to propose a resolution for mandatory singing of 'Tamil Thai Vazhthu' at state events.
items.summary_en: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister Vijay plans to propose a resolution. It would make singing the state song 'Tamil Thai Vazhthu' mandatory at state events. The proposal will go before the state Assembly.

items.raw_excerpt: Ohakune will be without tap water until Tuesday evening, after the district council confirmed the outage affecting the central North Island town would last longer than first feared.
items.summary_en: Ohakune will be without tap water until Tuesday evening. The district council says the outage will last longer than first feared. Local businesses are struggling without water.
items.summary_ko: 오하쿠네의 수돗물 중단이 예상보다 오래 이어질 예정이다. 지방 의회는 화요일 저녁에야 수돗물이 다시 나올 것이라고 밝혔다. 현지 상점들이 물 없이 큰 어려움을 겪고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Este complejo, el primero en su tipo en tierras valencianas, presenta una exquisita arquitectura fruto de diferentes reformas a apreciar solo desde el exterior al no estar permitidas las visitas.
items.summary_en: This monastery is the first of its kind in the Valencia region. It shows exquisite architecture from several renovations. Since visits are not allowed, you can only admire it from the outside.
items.summary_ko: 이곳은 발렌시아 지방에서 처음 들어선 형태의 수도원입니다. 여러 차례 보수 공사를 거친 정교한 건축물을 자랑합니다. 방문객은 내부 관람이 불가해 바깥에서만 감상할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: A colossal Carthusian monastery in Valencia where cloistered life has stayed unchanged for centuries

items.title_original: El colosal monasterio cartujo de Valencia donde la vida en clausura se mantiene inalterable desde hace siglos - Viajes National Geographic

items.raw_excerpt: South Australia's Employment Tribunal has fined energy giant AGL after workers were exposed to lead during a decommissioning project at an Adelaide power station.
items.summary_en: A South Australian tribunal fined energy company AGL for exposing workers to lead. The exposure happened while AGL was decommissioning an old power station in Adelaide.

items.raw_excerpt: Politiker mener det er en skandale.
items.summary_en: A ship has been allowed to dock at a Norwegian port. Politicians say this is a scandal and that the ship should never have been allowed to berth here.

items.raw_excerpt: Nav Canada is testing a new digital aerodrome air traffic control program in Kingston, Ont,. one that will allow people to direct the movement of planes from a remote location — even a city away.
items.summary_en: Nav Canada is testing a new digital airport control program in Kingston, Ontario. Controllers can direct planes from far away, even from another city. The test lets people guide planes without being at the airport.
items.summary_ko: 내브 캐나다가 온타리오 킹스턴에서 새로운 디지털 공항 관제 프로그램을 시험하고 있습니다. 이 프로그램으로 관제사는 먼 곳, 심지어 다른 도시에서도 비행기의 움직임을 지휘할 수 있습니다. 공항에 없어도 비행기를 이끌 수 있는 방식입니다.
items.title_en: Air traffic controllers test remote control in Kingston
items.title_ko: 킹스턴에서 원격 항공 관제를 시험하다

items.raw_excerpt: Aos 86 anos, o padre Domingos Costa concretizou um projeto que demorou 11 anos a nascer e hoje dá aos…
items.summary_en: Father Domingos Costa, 86, finished a project that took 11 years to complete. He built a small village with 26 houses. Elderly people can live there with their own independence.
items.summary_ko: 도밍구스 코스타 신부는 86세에 11년이 걸린 계획을 마침내 완성했다. 어르신들이 스스로 자립하며 살 수 있도록 집 26채로 이뤄진 작은 마을을 지은 것이다.
items.title_en: Priest builds village of 26 houses for elderly people
items.title_ko: 86세 신부, 어르신들이 자립해 살 수 있는 집 26채 마을을 만들다

items.raw_excerpt: Sicily’s Catania airport, a top Italian tourist destination, on Monday announced another suspension on arrivals due to ongoing ash emissions from Mount Etna.
items.summary_en: Catania airport in Sicily stopped arrivals again on Monday. A new ash cloud from Mount Etna is behind the closure. The airport is a popular entry point for Italian tourists.
items.summary_ko: 시칠리아의 카타니아 공항이 월요일 도착편 운항을 다시 중단했습니다. 에트나 화산에서 나온 새로운 화산재 구름 때문입니다. 카타니아 공항은 이탈리아 관광객이 많이 찾는 주요 입국 지점입니다.
items.title_en: Mount Etna ash forces Catania airport to close again
items.title_ko: 에트나 화산재로 카타니아 공항 또 폐쇄

items.raw_excerpt: The 'ventepølse' acts almost as an appetiser when Norwegians gather around the grill.
items.summary_en: A 'ventepølse' is a small sausage Norwegians eat while they wait for the grill to be ready. It works almost like an appetiser at a barbecue. The word literally means 'waiting sausage'.
items.summary_ko: 벤테푈세는 노르웨이 사람들이 불판이 준비되기를 기다리는 동안 먹는 작은 소시지입니다. 바비큐 앞에서 전채 요리처럼 먹는 음식이지요. 이 단어는 '기다리는 소시지'라는 뜻입니다.

items.title_ko: 노르웨이 오늘의 단어: '벤테푈세'
items.title_original: Norwegian word of the day: Ventepølse

items.raw_excerpt: The Netherlands is facing another hot, dry week, with temperatures climbing back above 30° from Wednesday and reaching 34 to 36° in the south by Thursday and Friday. Monday and Tuesday will be cooler, staying under 30°, with some clouds and a chance of light rain in the north, but too little to ease the drought. The clear spell is good news for the partial solar eclipse on Wednesday evening, when the moon will cover up to nearly 90% of...
items.summary_en: The Netherlands faces another hot, dry week. Temperatures will rise above 30°C from Wednesday, reaching 34 to 36°C in the south. Clear skies are good news for the partial solar eclipse on Wednesday evening.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드에 또 한 주의 덥고 건조한 날씨가 찾아옵니다. 수요일부터 기온이 30도 이상으로 오르고, 남부 지역은 목요일과 금요일에 34~36도까지 오르겠습니다. 맑은 하늘이 수요일 저녁 부분일식을 보기에 좋은 소식입니다.
items.title_en: Heat returns, clear skies for Wednesday's eclipse
items.title_ko: 무더위가 다시 찾아오고, 수요일 저녁 부분일식은 맑은 하늘에서 보인다
items.title_original: Heat returns as skies clear for Wednesday’s eclipse

items.raw_excerpt: PADUA: Sheltered from the blazing summer sun, a group of scientists in the northern Italian city of Padua spent weeks in a laboratory finalising an instrument they say could transform the study of the solar corona, the outer layer of the sun's atmosphere.As a total solar eclipse sweeps across Europe on Wednes
items.summary_en: Scientists in Padua, a city in northern Italy, worked for weeks in a laboratory on a new instrument. They say it could change how people study the outer layer of the sun, called the corona. A total solar eclipse will pass over Europe on Wednesday and become their big test.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아 북부 도시 파도바에서 과학자들이 몇 주 동안 실험실에 머물며 새 관측 장비를 완성했다. 이 장비는 태양 대기의 바깥층인 코로나를 연구하는 방식을 바꿀 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 수요일 유럽을 가로지르는 개기일식이 그들의 큰 시험 무대가 될 예정이다.
items.title_en: Italian scientists finish new sun instrument before big eclipse test
items.title_ko: 이탈리아 과학자들, 개기일식 시험 앞두고 새 태양 관측 장비 마무리
items.title_original: Italian scientists ready new solar instrument for high-stakes eclipse test

items.raw_excerpt: A Danish SS soldier was a sperm donor in the 1960s thanks to Sweden's Karolinska hospital. He is the biological father to at least 15 children who now want to know if they are the result of an ideological racial project.
items.summary_en: A Danish SS soldier gave sperm at Sweden's Karolinska hospital in the 1960s. He is the biological father of at least 15 children. Those children now want to know if they were part of an ideological racial plan.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 출신 나치 친위대 군인이 1960년대 스웨덴 카롤린스카 병원에서 정자를 기증했다. 그는 최소 15명 아이들의 친아버지다. 이제 그 아이들은 자신들이 인종주의적 계획의 결과인지 알고 싶어 한다.
items.title_en: Danish Nazi was a sperm donor in Sweden in the 1960s
items.title_ko: 덴마크 출신 나치 군인이 스웨덴에서 정자 기증자였다
items.title_original: Danish Nazi became sperm donor in Sweden – now his children want answers
